premises.text: Cholera outbreaks are a significant problem in Haiti and globally, leading to substantial losses.
premises.evidence_span: there are five million cholera cases every year in 41 different countries, and this leads to $3 billion in losses from productivity, human cost, and therapy.

premises.text: Current cholera detection methods are slow, expensive, and require expertise.
premises.evidence_span: It takes seven days to detect four cholera in water.

premises.text: OmniViz can detect cholera in water in under 30 minutes using a portable system.
premises.evidence_span: we do this by detecting four cholera in water, anywhere in the world, in under 30 minutes.

premises.text: The system includes a hardware component, a disposable test kit, and a smartphone app.
premises.evidence_span: We have a hardware component, disposable test kit, and a smartphone that works seamlessly together.

premises.text: The hardware component acts as a portable laboratory for DNA amplification.
premises.evidence_span: The hardware acts like the portable laboratory. It has a heating unit in order to do DNA amplification.

premises.text: The test kit contains reagents for DNA amplification to detect cholera.
premises.evidence_span: The test kit has reagents inside for DNA amplification.

premises.text: The smartphone app provides real-time data on cholera outbreaks.
premises.evidence_span: we're able to see where and when cholera has happened, and notify people.

premises.text: OmniViz has pending patents for its viscosity detection technique.
premises.evidence_span: We have two pending patents for this viscosity technique.

premises.text: The business model includes B2B sales of hardware and recurring revenue from test kits.
premises.evidence_span: We do a B2B sales model where our hardware is a single time purchase, and our disposable test kits create the recurring revenue.

premises.text: The market for cholera detection and surveillance is significant.
premises.evidence_span: Cholera is a two billion dollar market for water detection and surveillance.

premises.text: OmniViz can adapt its technology to detect various diseases beyond cholera.
premises.evidence_span: we change out the chemistry in our disposable test kits, and we can detect for many diseases in many different markets.

value.text: Rapid detection of cholera and other pathogens can save lives.
value.evidence_span: Omniviz mobilizes the lab, rapidly detecting pathogens, saving lives.

notes: Pending patents and letters of intent are included as premises; fundraising and demo offers are excluded.
